class.name: SteamCommerceBackend
class.brief_description: Script adapter for the game's authenticated purchasing service.
class.description: Implement the virtual hooks and complete the supplied request once, on the main thread. For asynchronous transport, retain the request until the game backend replies. Bind the adapter with [method SteamProvider.with_commerce_backend].

method.name: _catalog
method.description: Fetch the current player's server-priced offers and call [method SteamCommerceRequest.complete_catalog].

method.name: _begin
method.description: Create or resume the persisted order for this checkout ID and authenticated account. On success, echo the checkout ID in the typed response.

method.name: _observe_authorization
method.description: Use Steam's authorization hint to ask the game backend to query the known order. Return the verified backend state. The hint alone does not grant an entitlement.

method.name: _order
method.description: Refresh the current authenticated player's exact order from the game backend.
